title: Tenure Share of the CondoGuard Deductible Credit
content:
**Does the age of a CondoGuard policy change the credit for a higher deductible?** Yes. On the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy, the tenure share of the deductible credit is 1.10 when the policy has been in force for 120 or more whole months since its first inception date, 1.05 when it has been in force for 60 to 119 whole months, and 1.00 when it has been in force for fewer than 60 whole months. The share is applied to the product of the annual premium in force and the deductible step credit, before the full-year deductible credit is rounded. Where that product carries more than one deductible credit share, the shares are first multiplied together and then applied once to the product; none of them acts on the result of another.

**How is tenure measured?** In whole months from the first inception date shown on the policy record to the day of the raise; a part month is not counted.

| Whole months in force since first inception | Tenure share |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 1.10 |
| 60 to 119 | 1.05 |
| fewer than 60 | 1.00, no tenure increase |

**Worked questions (hypothetical policies).**

- *119 whole months in force?* 1.05. *120?* 1.10.
- *59 whole months?* 1.00. *60?* 1.05.
- *The figure?* A product of 85.00 USD (annual premium in force multiplied by the step credit) with 1.10 as the only share on it gives 85.00 multiplied by 1.10, 93.50 USD for the full-year deductible credit.
